ORDER This Criminal Original petition has been filed seeking to modify one of the conditions imposed on the petitioner in order page no.3(1) vide order dated 03.09.2024 made in Crl.M.P.No.2353 of 2024 passed by the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Chengalpattu.

The learned Counsel for the petitioner would contend that a case was registered against the accused person in Crime No.06 of 2024 on the file of the respondent police for the alleged offences under Sections 417 and 376(1) of IPC and he was arrested and remanded into judicial custody on 26.07.2024.
The petitioner/accused person has moved an bail application before the the Principal District and Sessions Judge, Chengalpattu in Crl.M.P.No.2353 of 2024 and the same was ordered on 03.09.2024.

entities.text: Principal District and Sessions Judge, Chengalpattu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
The trial Court granted bail to the petitioner with the following condition :
1.

The petitioner is directed to deposit a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh o n l y ) b y w a y o f D e m a n d D r a f t , i n t o t h e a c c o u n t o f D i s t r i c t https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Pallavarm concerned in Cr.No.06 of 2024 of All Women Police Station, Tambaram and on such deposit, the petitioner/accused is ordered to be released on bail on his execution of bond for Rs.10,000/- with two sureties each for a like sum to the satisfaction of the District Munsif-cum-Judicial Magistrate, Pallavaram.
He further submitted that the petitioner is poor and is unable to pay the amount as per the aforesaid condition.

3. The learned Government Advocate (Crl.Side) raised objection stating that the petitioner was involved in the alleged offences under Sections 417 and 376(1) of IPC and he was arrested and remanded into judicial custody on 26.07.2024.
Hence, this modification petition is liable to be dismissed.

4. Considering the submission made by both the counsel and considering the nature of offences charged against the petitioner and that the condition imposed by the Principal District and Sessions Judge, https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Chengalpattu directing  the petitioner to deposit a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lakh only) by way of Demand Draft, into the account of District Munsif cum Judicial Magistrate, Pallavarm concerned in Cr.No.06 of 2024 of All Women Police Station, Tambaram and on such deposit, the petitioner/accused is ordered to be released on bail.. is onerous condition and hence, this Court is inclined to modify the condition (1) imposed on the petitioner in the bail order in Crl.M.P.No.2353 of 2024 dated 03.09.2024 passed by the Principal District and Sessions Judge,
Chengalpattu.

entities.text:
Principal District and Sessions Judge,
Chengalpattu
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Accordingly, condition (1) is modified as The petitioner is ordered to be released on bail on his execution of bond for Rs.10,000/-
with two sureties each for a like sum to the satisfaction of the District Munsif-cum-Judicial Magistrate, Pallavaram.

The other conditions imposed by the Principal District and Sessions Judge,
Chengalpattu vide order dated 03.09.2024 in Crl.M.P.No.2353 of 2024 remains intact.
5. Accordingly, this Criminal Original Petition is allowed.
